title: office.extract request

reconcile.description: Meeting only: finish filing a meeting whose extraction is saved, from its filing record, without transcribing, extracting or feeding the ledger again.

description: Meeting profile without id runs the meeting inbox. With id it saves summary.md and to-dos; task is optional for meeting and adds a result artifact when supplied. Every to-do gets a per-item filing outcome; when one is not filed, summary.md waits and `reconcile: true` finishes the filing later.
